earlier_sources: https://github.com/librefonts/comingsoon at 27c886594addb8deb44976ee37f829f2c8253a9d: version 1.000 as built, dumped to TTX, and its metadata; no source. The release converted here is version 1.002, Google Fonts' 2017 contour fix.
disclose: The release kerns through a GPOS kern feature and also carries a legacy `kern` table (861 pairs). Shapers read the GPOS feature, which these sources keep; the legacy table, read only by software without GPOS support, is not carried.

The release has no glyph instructions: its font program defines functions that no glyph calls, and its control value program only turns on dropout control (SCANCTRL 511, SCANTYPE 4). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, and the build is hinted by ttfautohint, as for every release that has a font program: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
